description: This file defines the object 'CleanupDynamicPruningFilters', a rule for optimizing Spark SQL logical plans by removing unnecessary dynamic pruning filter nodes that were not pushed down to data sources or scans.

classes.name: CleanupDynamicPruningFilters
classes.description: An object implementing a rule to clean up unnecessary dynamic pruning filters in Spark logical plans.

methods.name: collectEqualityConditionExpressions
methods.description: Collects equality condition expressions from a given logical expression, focusing on deterministic and foldable expressions.

methods.name: removeUnnecessaryDynamicPruningSubquery
methods.description: Removes dynamic pruning subqueries from a plan if they are redundant due to existing equality conditions.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Main method applying the rule to a logical plan, removing unnecessary dynamic pruning filters based on plan patterns and configuration.
